name: hotelpro-hotel-booking-and-management-system
description: HotelPro – Complete Hotel Booking and Management System (MERN Stack)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'start'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: HotelPro Team
